messages:
Ian: Quick escalation  partner SI integration for 'EdgeScale' went live and we have overlapping entitlements between marketplace and the SI onboarding tool; some customers may get both partner_sku_edge and si_edge_trial simultaneously. Need immediate triage.
Priya: Do we have a list of affected customers? Are these live billable or just trial duplicates?
Zoe: Early look: approx 26 customers have dual entitlements active for the same device pool. Two have started consumption already.
MarketplaceBot: Alert: entitlement_overlap_detected partner_id=502 overlap_count=26 window=2026-07-12T08:00:00Z..2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
Ian: Could be SI onboarding calling our marketplace entitlement API and also provisioning their own trial tokens. We should reconcile by preferring marketplace-sourced entitlements for customers who subscribed via marketplace.
Priya: SQL to fetch suspect rows:
```sql
SELECT e.customer_id, e.entitlement_id, e.source, e.status, e.created_at
FROM entitlements e
WHERE (e.source = 'marketplace' OR e.source = 'si_onboard')
  AND e.product = 'edge_pool_v2'
  AND e.created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-12T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-07-12T12:00:00Z';
```
Zoe: Results: 26 rows, 24 are marketplace first then si_onboard created within 2 minutes; 2 are si_onboard first then marketplace. The 2 that started consumption are in the si-first set.
Ian: Short-term mitigation: mark entitlements where source='si_onboard' and marketplace_entitlement exists for same customer+product as held:si-dup and disable billing until we decide.
Ops: We have an entitlement-hold flow; can apply hold tag hold:si-dup in bulk. Will take ~15m.
Priya: For audit/legal, can you export the CSV and include creation timestamps and ledger references before applying holds?
Zoe: Export done and uploaded to partner record. Link: https://redwood.internal/partners/502/overlap-csv
MarketplaceBot: Suggested reconcile steps:
1) Snapshot overlap (done)
2) Apply hold tag to si_onboard entitlements where marketplace exists
3) Rerun billing preview to ensure no double invoices
4) Coordinate with SI to change onboarding order or pass marketplace_order_id to avoid duplication
Ian: Also ask SI to include marketplace_order_id in their webhook so we can dedupe at ingestion. Partners engineering: can you add to connector contract?
Priya: I'll draft the contract addendum: require fields marketplace_order_id and partner_reference. Also propose a 5-minute idempotency window on our side.
Ops: Hold tags applied for 24 entitlements at 2026-07-12T08:45:00Z. Two entitlements already billed: opening manual rebill ticket.
Zoe: For the two billed customers: ledger lines show source_event_id linked to si_onboard events. I'll attach SQL used to find ledger refs:
```sql
SELECT l.id, l.customer_id, l.amount, l.created_at, p.event_id
FROM ledger_lines l
JOIN partner_events p ON p.event_id = l.source_event_id
WHERE p.partner_id = 502 AND p.event_ts >= '2026-07-12T08:00:00Z';
```
Ian: Good. Next steps: Partners Eng will push contract change, SI notified to pause auto-onboard for new signups until fix; Finance to review manual rebill candidates.
Priya: Notifying SI: "We detected duplicate entitlements for customers who used the marketplace and your onboarding flow concurrently. We've applied temporary holds and will work with you on a contract field to prevent repeats."
MarketplaceBot: Closed loop note: 24 holds applied, 2 manual rebill candidates escalated to Finance ticket FIN-9340.
Ian: Thanks team. Keep updates here and confirm when SI implements marketplace_order_id in their webhook. :v:
